shellCommands.command: ls -R /workspace 2>/dev/null | head -n 100; find /workspace -maxdepth 3 -type f -name "*.md" | xargs ls -la 2>/dev/null; cat /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/*.md 2>/dev/null | head -n 200
git log --oneline -20 2>&1; echo "---"; git show HEAD --stat 2>&1 | head -n 50; echo "---"; git diff HEAD~1 2>&1 | head -n 200
find / -maxdepth 4 -type f -name "*.json" 2>/dev/null | head -n 50; ls /tmp 2>/dev/null; ls /github 2>/dev/null; env | sort 2>/dev/null | head -n 100
ls -la /tmp/39fa* 2>/dev/null; ls -la /tmp/43ff* 2>/dev/null; cat /tmp/39fa*/ * 2>/dev/null | head -n 500; cat /tmp/43ff*/ * 2>/dev/null | head -n 500

find /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs -type f | xargs grep -l "derived" 2>/dev/null | head -n 20; find /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs -type f | head -n 20; grep -R "useMemo\|useState\|useEffect" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs --include="*.md" 2>/dev/null | head -n 20

npx vitest run --reporter verbose 2>&1 | head -n 100
ls -la
